# TASK-81 handoff — Flight: maxVelocity is not a top speed

## Status

criteria are met, and every gate is green (unit, tsc, e2e, lint). What remains is
bookkeeping only: the LOG.md entry, setting the pass flags, and the commit — a
~10-minute close-out that fits one iteration with large margin.

   and velocity actually redirected; (c) maxVelocity+30 with full thrust → speed

   suite passed unchanged — `src/server/shard/ai.test.ts`,
   `src/client/world/streaming-benchmark.test.ts`, `tests/abuse/abuse.spec.ts`
   (max-step bound `vmax * 0.1 * 2.5` still has margin) all pass; the AI was NOT
   relying on the overshoot (note this in the LOG entry).

   W it asserts server-reported top speed ≤ 121 and > 5, and saves a new screenshot
   `.ralph/screenshots/TASK-81-1.png`. Measured in the green run: **top-speed=120.0 u/s**.
   Measured top speeds per class (unit run, full thrust 60 s): scout 120.000 (pre
   ~160), freighter 60.000 (pre ~72), interceptor 180.000 (pre ~250).
5. **Verification state at handoff** (all green, post-fix):
   - `cd app && npm run test` → 182 files, 1655 passed / 1 skipped, 0 failed
